headline: Economists warn Philippine Central Bank against premature rate pause amid slowflation
summary: Economists warned the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) that while tightening capacity is constrained by slowing economic growth, pausing interest rate moves prematurely carries risks due to broadening inflation pressures.
why: Central bank policy decisions steer interest rate expectations, commercial lending rates, and currency values.

impacts.name: Philippine Policy Rate
impacts.why: Debate over central bank interest rate strategy influences local money market expectations.
